'''Azabi''' was a [[Private/Legends|private]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] Azabi was [[Death/Legends|killed]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], near the [[Lower City Hydro Station]], which Azabi and 3 other privates attempted to sabotage.
